confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three web searches. These covered the RBA rate, Numbeo/Expatica-style cost-of-living aggregates for Pisa, and Expatistan's cocktail and wine pages. I converted euro prices to USD using an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16. I did not look that rate up. Sources: inexpensive meal about €15-18, mid-range dinner for two about €50-72, cappuccino about €1.8-2.0, draft beer about €3.5-6.25. I took beer as roughly €5.0-5.5 for a restaurant serving. The one cocktail data point was about €6 at a downtown club, from only 7 price points. I raised that to about €9 for a typical restaurant or bar cocktail. No per-glass wine price was found. I estimated about €5 per glass from the Expatistan bottle price of about €8 and the beer price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak-season demand, not from any searched or inspected listings, and carry the most uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pisa is a mid-sized Tuscan university and tourist city. I benchmarked it against Italian cost-of-living aggregates for Pisa, with accommodation set slightly below Florence and above typical smaller Italian cities.
